title: Christine Nelson, the Glessners' parlor maid, walks round the block
items: Christine Nelson, the Swedish parlor maid the 1900 census finds in the house, now walks round the Glessner block on its sidewalks with a market basket in her hand, up Prairie Avenue and along Eighteenth Street past the house, and on round. Walk up to her to open her card.

She wears a young working woman's street clothes of the decade, after a shirtwaist and a straw boater in the Met and photographs of working women: a white shirtwaist with a black bow, a navy walking skirt clear of the ground, and a straw sailor hat.
People walking a route now keep walking when you are not near, so she comes round again.
